scares.description: Some ice cubes fall out of a refrigerator ice machine which makes a loud noise in an otherwise quiet scene.
Jill opens the door and a detective is standing on the other side.
Tracy almost trips over a homeless man while walking up some steps.
Duncan appears from around a corner and puts his hand over Tracy’s mouth.
Jill tries to wake up her husband however the man beside her in the bed is revealed to be Duncan. [Video]
